fixture: 722 of Harsh's Wispr Flow dictations (92,291 words) on this Mac: Wispr's raw recognizer text paired with Wispr's final formatted text. Score = word-level distance from SpeakEasy Clean output to Wispr's final text, lower is closer. Rules were kept only if they moved closer without changing meaning; rules that hurt ("go ahead and", "gonna", "wanna", bare "basically", "like" before articles, sentence-initial "so") were removed. No transcript text is committed.
